title: queued: what the seat has queued, each entry with its place
description: The answer of queued (decision 0221, rule 15): the seat's queued orders and commands, in the order pulse, dusk, commands, each as it was given. An entry's place is its queue and its number there, from 1; take_back names it. as_of changes whenever the queues change or the clock moves, and take_back must be given it. Orders and commands are written in the side's numbers, as issue_orders and the command tools take them. It lists nothing of the enemy.

day.description: The day whose pulse is next: the open day at 0600 or 1200, the coming day at dusk.

next_pulse.description: null once the game is over.

queue.description: pulse: orders for the next pulse of the open day; dusk: orders given at 1800 for the coming day; commands: commands taken in at the coming day's start.

day.description: The day the entry is given for: the day after the open day, or the coming day.

entry.description: An order has unit and order; a command has tool and command. goes_with lists the entries taken back with this one (rule 16); rests_on, for a hold, the queued orders to its unit.

order.description: The order body as issue_orders takes it, in the side's numbers.
